|-------------|----------------------|

| Fiscal Year | COGS (thousands CAD) |
|-------------|----------------------|
| FY 2022 | $839,678 |
| FY 2023 | $1,281,638 |

**Aritzia had a significantly larger percentage change in COGS**, increasing by **52.6%** from fiscal 2022 to fiscal 2023, compared to Lululemon's **10.8%** increase over the same period.
